outputs.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence images of lungs; no plotted data with error bars, so none needed.
PASS - Bar graph shows error bars and caption explicitly states 'Plot represents mean ± SD.'
PASS - Panel C consists of histology/RNAscope images and spatial transcriptomic heatmaps, not quantitative plots requiring error bars.
PASS - GSEA enrichment plots display enrichment score curves with NES/FDR/p values, not mean±error representations, so error bars are not applicable.
PASS - Bar graph shows log2 fold change with p-values annotated per bar; no error bars are displayed and none are claimed, so this is acceptable for this type of DEG summary plot.
PASS - Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a quantitative plot, so error bars are not applicable.
